caption: The drawing depicts a round, metal object with a perforated surface, suggesting ventilation or drainage functions. The object sits on a flat, neutral background with no additional items present. It has a cylindrical body with a flat, circular top and bottom. The top is fitted with a metal handle, arched upwards and attached at two points on either side. The body and the lid are both rusted, displaying shades of brown and dark gray, with the rust giving a speckled texture. The object also features a small hinged door on the front, outlined by a seam, and secured with a circular knob or latch. The entire surface is dotted with small holes, arranged in a subtle, geometric pattern. There are traces of wood or wood-like texture, particularly on the top rim, which is medium brown in color. The composition is centered, and the object is drawn with fine lines and detailed shading, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The name "Maria Ermolaev" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Foot Warmer
